title: Arena benchmark tool descriptors and handlers

claims.text: TOOLS exposes bench_list, bench_declare, bench_run, bench_status and bench_verdict with read or journal effects.
_handler routes bench_list to bench.list_benches, bench_status to bench.status, and mutations through bench.declare, bench.run and bench.verdict with a registry Command.
VALIDATORS maps bench.declared, bench.result and bench.verdict to bench domain validators and FOLDS maps arena to _ArenaFold.
_validate delegates arena schema definitions to bank._check and _preflight lowers oneOf and exclusive bounds for compatibility.

decision.rule: Change here when arena tool schemas, bench routing, validators or arena fold ownership needs to change.
decision.failure: A bench tool dispatches with a missing agent default, a validator is absent for a bench kind, or arena schema checks silently pass.

questions.q: Where are the bench tool schemas and handlers registered for discovery?
Where should I change how bench handlers build the registry Command and context?
Where can I debug a bench validator or arena fold that fails to load?
